newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales unchanged - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales unchanged - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales were unchanged in the week ended February 1 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index, released Tuesday.
Sales for the week were up 6.4 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was up 0.3 percent from the prior month.
"Sales were generally on to above plan for most retailers. Department stores were the best performing segment of the business over the latest week," said the report.
